description: Defines a repository class for managing external HARQ buffer contexts in a hardware-accelerated communication system, including related data structures, constants, and methods for buffer management.

classes.name: ext_harq_buffer_context_repository
classes.description: Manages a collection of HARQ buffer context entries, providing methods to access and free entries, with capacity checks and debug support.

methods.name: ext_harq_buffer_context_repository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with capacity checks based on buffer size and number of codeblocks.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a buffer context entry for a given codeblock ID, optionally resetting it for new data.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees a buffer context entry for a given codeblock ID, unless debug mode is enabled.
